## Change

Explain the resulting behavior or documentation change.

## Reason

Explain the problem and why this change solves it.

## Verification

List the exact checks run and their results. Include relevant failure-path checks.

## Limitations

State anything unresolved, or write "None."

## Before review

- [ ] The title and commit subjects follow the four-type commit policy.
- [ ] The branch is current with main.
- [ ] Baseline and final checks passed.
- [ ] The diff contains only intended files and no secrets or customer data.
- [ ] Required documentation and behavior tests are included where applicable.
